messages:
sara (Support): forwarding ticket #8721 from ACME — they say credits aren't decrementing for streaming responses, then later they sometimes see duplicate charges after client retries. attaching customer repro.
alex (Support): thanks. can you paste minimal repro and example request/headers? specifically idempotency or request-id used?
sara (Support): steps:
1) client calls /v1/chat/stream with streaming=true, no idempotency-key header
2) network hiccup, client retries after 3s
3) customer sees N tokens in dashboard but balance unchanged. a minute later another ledger entry appears and balance drops by ~2x
example curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize this..."}],"stream":true}'
```
(note: client library does exponential retry, no idempotency-key added)
maya (Billing): thanks. our dedupe expects an `x-rw-idempotency-key` (or `Idempotency-Key`) per request. if retries omit it we can double-record. can you send the request IDs / timestamps from the customer's logs?
rami (Eng): fyi there is a known edge-case where aborted streaming connections sometimes create an interim usage record but fail to commit the final accounting row; if a retry then completes, ledger can end up with two entries. this is the runtime bug I flagged last month.
sara (Support): sending logs from customer (redacted):
```
[2026-03-09T14:02:12Z] req_id=rx-7f3a stream_start ok
[2026-03-09T14:02:15Z] req_id=rx-7f3a conn_reset client
[2026-03-09T14:02:18Z] req_id=rx-8b4c retry start
[2026-03-09T14:02:30Z] req_id=rx-8b4c stream_complete tokens=412
[2026-03-09T14:02:35Z] ledger: usage_insert req_ref=rx-7f3a status=partial
[2026-03-09T14:02:36Z] ledger: usage_insert req_ref=rx-8b4c status=complete
```
ops-bot: billing-reconcile job #20260309-7 flagged mismatched usage rows for customer ACME: rx-7f3a vs rx-8b4c (possible duplicate). see /infra/logs/billing/2026-03-09
maya (Billing): I can see two usage rows for the session in the ledger. I'll pause auto-reconcile for that account and create a manual adjustment if Eng confirms root cause.
rami (Eng): confirmed. this matches the stream-abort -> partial-usage bug. short-term mitigation: require idempotency key at gateway and ignore repeated usage inserts for same idempotency/request hash. long-term: patch runtime to only write tentative usage on stream open and atomically commit on stream close. I'll open a PR and cut a hotfix. ETA ~4h for hotfix rollout, then I'll run a script to collapse dup rows into one.
maya (Billing): once hotfix is deployed I'll prepare a customer-facing refund/adjustment. please tag me in the PR so I can sync ledger changes.
alex (Support): plan of record:
- Eng (rami) pushes hotfix -> runtime atomic-commit for streams (ETA 4h)
- Billing (maya) pauses reconcile + prepares manual adjustment
- Support (sara) update ACME with acknowledgement + ETA
- Ops (ops-bot) will keep scanning for further duplicates
sara (Support): I'll send ACME a short update now: "we're investigating, likely double charge due to retries on streaming requests; we're rolling a hotfix and will adjust your balance if needed" :thumbsup:
rami (Eng): PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/834 (draft) — will mark ready in ~90m
maya (Billing): noted — holding on reconcile and will issue credit once eng confirms
alex (Support): thanks team. assign support owner to follow up with ACME after refund processed.
sara (Support): taking ownership. will post final resolution and close ticket when adjustment is applied. :white_check_mark:
